fields.task: path to a task JSON, resolved relative to this file

submission.arm: A0/A1 flat events; B0/B1 MPL Core; C0/C1 MPL+stdlib; suffix 1 means semantic feedback
submission.candidate: final candidate program, resolved relative to this file
submission.audio: optional rendered WAV for audio tasks
submission.renderManifest: optional Render Artifact Manifest; required to trust audio
submission.inputTokens: model input tokens consumed, including context and feedback
submission.outputTokens: model output tokens consumed, including repairs
submission.modelCalls: number of model calls; 0 means offline/imported
submission.error: provider or generation error, if any

result.modelGenerated: true only if at least one submission reports modelCalls > 0
result.observedSuccessRate: null unless modelGenerated and at least one run completed
result.runs: per-arm status, initialStatus, verification, token and latency records
